theme: Behavioural finance: volatility ≠ loss, avoiding panic selling, staying invested
headline: Market Swings Are Normal, Not Permanent Losses
body: Volatility is price movement, not actual loss. Panic selling locks in losses. Long-term investors benefit from staying put.
caption: Market ups and downs are part of investing. Reacting emotionally to short-term swings often hurts returns more than markets themselves. Understanding this helps you make calmer decisions. #BehavioralFinance #InvestingTips #StayInvested #MarketVolatility #LongTermWealth
